race.comment: Good little race and BILLYCART (8) is the clear horse to beat. Put a gap on them on debut at Kilmore then went to the 1800m Listed race on Melbourne Cup Day and picked up very strongly late to race away and win by 2.25 lengths. Looks a lovely staying prospect for Tage Weir and really should be too strong again. If there's a danger, it's the Frankel gelding FRANKED UP (4) who bolted in on debut at Ballarat over 1600m, sent out $1.75 and putting paid to his rivals by 5 lengths. He'll relish the extra trip and will be the one BILLYCART has to run down. TOWN PLANNER (3) is a progressive horse in his own right, winning well on debut then good against the older horses at Donald. He can measure up. GILGEOUS (1) was well off BILLYCART at Flemington but has done good things either side, just wonder how much he's got left in the tank. CHIP IN (2) won well at Seymour last time and is in the mix.
